standing_prohibition: A pass whose control did not separate is NOT_RUN, never clean. Narrowing a pass, widening an exemption, or downgrading a finding after seeing it invalidates the round.
why_convergence_is_not_declared: The stop rule requires two consecutive clean rounds under this protocol, with every finding from the preceding round closed. This tool reports rounds; it does not decide that a round was enough. Round 6 of a minimum of 2, with 0 consecutive clean.
